Several days (you need to finish the A Pirate's Tail Quest); the addons are instant with the items

The {wiki:Rascoohan Outfits|Rascoohan Outfits} are the reward for helping the Rascoohan people against the Pirats. The base outfit is received on finishing the {wiki:A Pirate's Tail Quest|A Pirate's Tail Quest} by defeating {creature:Ratmiral Blackwhiskers}; the two addons are obtained by using a {item:Soap} and a {item:Scrubbing Brush}. With both addons you earn the achievement **Honorary Rascoohan**.
Honour the Rascoohan people with special gifts and receive their permission to wear the typical Rascoohan clothes.
Eustacio, Venore (start of the A Pirate's Tail Quest)
Minimum level unknown, but the **recommended level is 250** (A Pirate's Tail Quest bosses).
For the base outfit: complete the {wiki:A Pirate's Tail Quest|A Pirate's Tail Quest}, defeating {creature:Ratmiral Blackwhiskers}.
for the first addon (dropped by Ratmiral Blackwhiskers)
for the second addon (dropped by Ratmiral Blackwhiskers)
The {item:Soap} and the {item:Scrubbing Brush} drop from {creature:Ratmiral Blackwhiskers}. Since you can fight him several times, keep these items when they drop.
This quest has no Quest Log entry.
You also face all kinds of {wiki:Pirats|Pirats} and the A Pirate's Tail Quest bosses on the way.

Start the {wiki:A Pirate's Tail Quest|A Pirate's Tail Quest} with {npc:Eustacio}, in Venore, and complete it until you reach {wiki:The Wreckoning|The Wreckoning} (see that quest's guide for all the steps).

On the first visit, travel to **Issavi** and use the small shell **north of the depot**. In the cave, go down at the first spot, up at the second and up again at the third until you come out on the surface of the island of {wiki:Rascacoon}. After talking to {npc:Tik'hi Tak'he} for the first time, you get a shortcut: in Venore, ask {npc:Eustacio} for {key:shortcut} to go straight to the island.
Shell north of the Issavi depot
Go up here (exit to the island)

To reach the Pirats' hideout you need to have exchanged **1200 Trust Points** with Tik'hi Tak'he and defeated {creature:Tentugly's Head|Tentugly} (see the A Pirate's Tail Quest guide). Step into the teleport in the **southeast** of Rascacoon and go up **one floor** to the ship of {npc:Captain Jack Rat}. The first time, the trip includes the fight against Tentugly; after that, to return to {wiki:The Wreckoning} you just have to say {key:sail}, {key:safe}, {key:yes} to him.
Teleport in the southeast of Rascacoon
In The Wreckoning, step into the teleport for the fight and defeat {creature:Ratmiral Blackwhiskers}. He is the one who drops the {item:Soap} and the {item:Scrubbing Brush} you need for the addons.
It's a team boss with four phases and a lot of Life Drain damage. Follow the instructions in the A Pirate's Tail Quest guide.

After the fight, leave the island through The Wreckoning teleport (the wiki only says you can leave through it, without stating the destination). If you don't end up in Rascacoon, go to Venore and ask {npc:Eustacio} for {key:shortcut} to return to the island and talk to Tik'hi Tak'he, who is in the **west** of the island.
After defeating the Ratmiral, talk to {npc:Tik'hi Tak'he} and say {key:hi}, {key:mission}. You receive the base {wiki:Rascoohan Outfits|Rascoohan Outfit}.
Every time you defeat the Ratmiral you also gain 100 Trust Points.
To return to Venore, use the small boat at the dock where you arrive via Eustacio's shortcut. You can also go back through the cave you came through from Issavi, retracing the path.
Use a {item:Soap}. You see the message *"You feel a bit more raccoonish."* and receive the first addon.
Use a {item:Scrubbing Brush}. You see the message *"Hmmm, trash cans!!"* and receive the second addon. With both items used you earn the **Honorary Rascoohan** achievement.
The quest goes through {wiki:Venore|Venore}, {wiki:Rascacoon|Rascacoon} and {wiki:The Wreckoning|The Wreckoning}.
